title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.
constraints:
2 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^4
-10^9 ≤ nums[i], target ≤ 10^9
Exactly one valid answer exists.

title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome, and false otherwise. Do not convert the integer to a string if solving in O(1) space.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets and in the correct order.
constraints:
1 ≤ s.length ≤ 10^4
s consists of parentheses only.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two sorted linked lists list1 and list2. Merge the two lists into one sorted list by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists.
constraints:
Number of nodes in both lists is in [0, 50]
-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.
constraints:
1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^5
-10^4 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^4

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. Choose a single day to buy one stock and a future day to sell. Return maximum profit.
constraints:
1 ≤ prices.length ≤ 10^5
0 ≤ prices[i] ≤ 10^4

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list head.
constraints:
Number of nodes in list is in [0, 5000]
-5000 ≤ Node.val ≤ 5000

title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the inorder traversal of its nodes' values.
constraints:
Number of nodes in tree is in [0, 100]
-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth (number of nodes along the longest path from root down to leaf).
constraints:
Number of nodes in tree is in [0, 10^4]
-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

title: Single Number
description: Given a non-empty array of integers nums, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one. Must implement with linear runtime and O(1) space.

title: Linked List Cycle
description: Given head, the head of a linked list, determine if the linked list has a cycle in it.
constraints:
Number of nodes in list is in [0, 10^4]
-10^5 ≤ Node.val ≤ 10^5

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.
constraints:
1 ≤ s.length, t.length ≤ 5 × 10^4
consisting of lowercase English letters.

title: Binary Search
description: Given an array of integers nums sorted in ascending order, and an integer target, write a function to search target in nums in O(log n) time.
constraints:
1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^4
all elements are unique and sorted.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase. It takes n steps to reach the top. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree (mirror left and right subtrees), and return its root.
constraints:
Number of nodes in tree is in [0, 100]
-100 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100

title: Add Two Numbers
description: Given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers stored in reverse order, add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list.
constraints:
Number of nodes in each list is in [1, 100]
0 ≤ Node.val ≤ 9

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
constraints:
0 ≤ s.length ≤ 5 × 10^4
s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s.
constraints:
1 ≤ s.length ≤ 1000
s consists of digits and English letters.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given an integer array height of length n. Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container containing the most water. Return maximum amount of water.
constraints: n == height.length, 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ height[i] ≤ 10^4

title: 3Sum
description: Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j, i != k, and j != k, and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0. The solution set must not contain duplicate triplets.
constraints:
3 ≤ nums.length ≤ 3000
-10^5 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^5

title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
description: Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return its head.
constraints: Number of nodes is sz, 1 ≤ sz ≤ 30, 0 ≤ Node.val ≤ 100, 1 ≤ n ≤ sz

title: Generate Parentheses
description: Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Given integer array nums sorted in ascending order with distinct values, rotated at an unknown pivot, and a target. Return index if found, else -1 in O(log n) time.
constraints: 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 5000, -10^4 ≤ nums[i], target ≤ 10^4. All values unique.

title: Combination Sum
description: Given an array of distinct integers candidates and a target integer, return a list of all unique combinations where chosen numbers sum to target. Same number may be chosen unlimited times.
constraints: 1 ≤ candidates.length ≤ 30, 2 ≤ candidates[i] ≤ 40, 1 ≤ target ≤ 40.

title: Permutations
description: Given an array nums of distinct integers, return all the possible permutations in any order.
constraints: 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 6, -10 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10. All integers unique.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order.
constraints: 1 ≤ strs.length ≤ 10^4, 0 ≤ strs[i].length ≤ 100. Lowercase English letters.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i], merge all overlapping intervals and return non-overlapping intervals that cover all intervals in input.
constraints: 1 ≤ intervals.length ≤ 10^4, intervals[i].length == 2, 0 ≤ start_i ≤ end_i ≤ 10^4.

title: Unique Paths
description: A robot is located at top-left of an m x n grid. It can only move either down or right. Return the number of possible unique paths to bottom-right corner.
constraints: 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 100. Answer fits in a 32-bit integer.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: Given an m x n integer matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0's in-place.
constraints: m == matrix.length, n == matrix[0].length, 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 200, -2^31 ≤ matrix[i][j] ≤ 2^31 - 1.

title: Word Search
description: Given an m x n grid of characters board and a string word, return true if word exists in the grid. Word must be constructed from sequentially adjacent cells.
constraints: m == board.length, n == board[i].length, 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 6, 1 ≤ word.length ≤ 15.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values (i.e., from left to right, level by level).
constraints: Number of nodes in tree is in [0, 2000], -1000 ≤ Node.val ≤ 1000.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST).
constraints: Number of nodes is in [1, 10^4], -2^31 ≤ Node.val ≤ 2^31 - 1.

title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder
description: Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder where preorder is preorder traversal and inorder is inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.
constraints: 1 ≤ preorder.length ≤ 3000, inorder.length == preorder.length, all values are unique.

title: Number of Islands
description: Given an m x n 2D binary grid grid representing a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.
constraints: m == grid.length, n == grid[i].length, 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300.

title: Course Schedule
description: There are a total of numCourses courses to take (0 to numCourses - 1). Given array prerequisites where prerequisites[i] = [a_i, b_i] indicates you must take course b_i before a_i. Return true if you can finish all courses.
constraints: 1 ≤ numCourses ≤ 2000, 0 ≤ prerequisites.length ≤ 5000, prerequisites[i].length == 2.

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
description: Implement the Trie class with insert(word), search(word), and startsWith(prefix) methods.
constraints: 1 ≤ word.length, prefix.length ≤ 2000, lowercase English letters. At most 3 × 10^4 calls total.

title: Coin Change
description: Given an integer array coins representing coins of different denominations and an integer amount, return fewest coins needed to make up amount. If not possible, return -1.
constraints: 1 ≤ coins.length ≤ 12, 1 ≤ coins[i] ≤ 2^31 - 1, 0 ≤ amount ≤ 10^4.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all elements of nums except nums[i]. Must run in O(n) time without using division.
constraints: 2 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^5, -30 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 30. Product fits in 32-bit integer.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 10^5, -10^4 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^4, k is in range [1, number of unique elements].

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2 of size m and n respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays. Time complexity should be O(log (m+n)).
constraints: nums1.length == m, nums2.length == n, 0 ≤ m, n ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ m + n ≤ 2000.

title: Merge k Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
constraints: k == lists.length, 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^4, 0 ≤ lists[i].length ≤ 500.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
constraints: n == height.length, 1 ≤ n ≤ 2 × 10^4, 0 ≤ height[i] ≤ 10^5.

title: N-Queens
description: The n-queens puzzle is the problem of placing n queens on an n x n chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Return all distinct solutions.

title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations required to convert word1 to word2 (Operations: insert character, delete character, replace character).
constraints: 0 ≤ word1.length, word2.length ≤ 500, consists of lowercase English letters.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given two strings s and t of lengths m and n, return the minimum window substring of s such that every character in t (including duplicates) is included in the window.
constraints: m == s.length, n == t.length, 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 10^5, uppercase & lowercase letters.

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given an array of integers heights representing the histogram's bar height where width of each bar is 1, return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
constraints: 1 ≤ heights.length ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ heights[i] ≤ 10^4.

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
description: A path in a binary tree is a sequence of nodes where each pair of adjacent nodes has an edge connecting them. Node can appear at most once. Return maximum path sum of any non-empty path.
constraints: Number of nodes in tree is in [1, 3 × 10^4], -1000 ≤ Node.val ≤ 1000.

title: Word Ladder
description: Given two words, beginWord and endWord, and a dictionary wordList, return length of shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord changing 1 letter at a time. Return 0 if impossible.
constraints: 1 ≤ beginWord.length ≤ 10, 1 ≤ wordList.length ≤ 5000, wordList[i].length == beginWord.length.

title: LRU Cache
category: Hash Table / Doubly Linked List / Design
description: Design a data structure that follows Least Recently Used (LRU) cache constraints. Implement get(key) and put(key, value) in O(1) average time complexity.
constraints: 1 ≤ capacity ≤ 3000, 0 ≤ key ≤ 10^4, 0 ≤ value ≤ 10^5. At most 2 × 10^5 calls to get/put.
